mapper.select: SELECT car_no AS carNo, COUNT(*) AS totalSeats FROM seat WHERE schedule_seq = #{scheduleSeq} GROUP BY car_no ORDER BY car_no ASC

SELECT st.seat_seq AS seatSeq, st.schedule_seq AS scheduleSeq, st.car_no AS carNo, st.seat_no AS seatNo, st.seat_grade AS seatGrade, COALESCE(r.status, 'HELD') AS status, st.version FROM seat st LEFT JOIN reservation r ON st.seat_seq = r.seat_seq AND r.status IN ('HELD', 'CONFIRMED') WHERE st.schedule_seq = #{scheduleSeq} AND st.car_no = #{carNo} AND st.seat_no = #{seatNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seat (schedule_seq, car_no, seat_no, seat_grade, version) VALUES (#{scheduleSeq}, #{carNo}, #{seatNo}, #{seatGrade}, 0) ON CONFLICT (schedule_seq, car_no, seat_no) DO NOTHING
